snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
Explore Cyrodiil like never before in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered, coming in 2026 to Nintendo Switch 2.

The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered modernizes the 2006 Game of the Year with all-new stunning visuals and refined gameplay. Explore the vast landscape of Cyrodiil and stop the forces of Oblivion from overtaking the land in this award-winning RPG from Bethesda Game Studios.
   
#TheElderScrollsIV #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
